policy: Only this ledger lists canonical Place releases after the frozen 361/659 P21 baseline.
New canonical releases must append an immutable release-manifest path with explicit baseline/proposed deltas; changing Place/source counts without that manifest fails CI.
Historical research manifests remain frozen; existing individual ID, geo provenance, confessional and title collision checks remain in force.
All older tests should derive live counts from this chain, not copy current numbers or rebuild a long arithmetic expression.
Shrine profiles, pilgrimages, TLM venues, images and historical exceptions are separate domains and never inferred from Place counts.
